dataset_info.name: gameops-chatbot-golden-v3
dataset_info.description: 50-item golden dataset based on golden-v3: 10 FAQ single-hop, 10 payment single-hop, 10 bug single-hop, 10 VOC single-hop, 5 FAQ multi-hop, and 5 payment multi-hop. FAQ items are document/RAG-grounded; payment items are grounded in the current local DB payment/refund/item_delivery/gacha fixtures. reference_answer is expected answer text, not a rubric.
paper_basis: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (EACL 2024)
StructGPT: A General Framework for LLM to Reason over Structured Data (2023)
ChatLR: Redefining Information Retrieval of Structured Database via LLMs (2025)
Enhancing Few-shot Text-to-SQL Capabilities of LLMs (2023)

design_notes.faq_single_hop: Single document-grounded FAQ/RAG cases for RAGAS-style answer/context evaluation.
design_notes.payment_single_hop: Single structured-source DB reasoning cases using current local fixtures; each case mainly targets one source family such as payments, refunds, item_delivery_logs, or gacha_logs.
design_notes.bug_single_hop: Conservative bug triage cases: identify symptom and ask for reproducible context without confirming fixes or compensation.
design_notes.voc_single_hop: Fixed-response VOC cases. reference_answer equals the VOC fixed response text.
design_notes.faq_multi_hop: Multi-hop RAG cases requiring two or more document-grounded claims, following RAGAS multi-context evaluation practice.
design_notes.payment_multi_hop: Multi-hop structured DB cases requiring account-scoped joins across payments/refunds/item_delivery_logs/gacha_logs, following StructGPT/ChatLR/Few-shot Text-to-SQL style structured reasoning.

dataset_info.db_fixture_source: current local DB tables: game_accounts, payments, refunds, item_delivery_logs, gacha_logs
dataset_info.evaluation_note: Use metadata.eval_slice for the requested 6-way split. Keep inputs.category and metadata.test_type compatible with existing category filters.
